simulation.draw_status: Draw U(x) with the mouse from left to right and press Apply.
simulation.bad_drawing: Draw a line over at least part of the graph.
simulation.hint:
Left mouse button on the upper graph draws potential energy.
 A new drawing starts from an empty graph.
simulation.demon_wait: The demon is waiting: let the particle through or reflect it.
simulation.demon_idle: The demon is watching. A decision is needed when a particle reaches the line.
simulation.playback_speed_hint: 1× is normal speed; below 1× slows down, above 1× speeds up.
simulation.speed_threshold_hint: Full speed √(vx² + vy²) in model units. Particles at the threshold belong to the slow group.

memory_game.title: Guess the beginning
memory_game.instructions: After a concealed evolution, guess the initial well.
memory_game.origin_hint: Random well is for solo play. A host may choose a well from the list or on the plot.
memory_game.temperature_hint: Temperature is set at preparation. The gas then evolves without a thermostat.
memory_game.setup_message: Prepare the experiment. The initial state is concealed.
memory_game.evolving_message: The experiment is running behind a closed screen…
memory_game.guess_message: This is the final state. Which well did it start in?
memory_game.result_message: Answer revealed. Compare the initial and final distributions.
memory_game.concealed: State concealed until the duration expires
memory_game.preview: The final state will appear here
memory_game.result_detail:
{verdict}. Initially: {origin}.
{retained} of {count} molecules remain in the initial well.
memory_game.error_need_wells: Draw two to six distinct wells separated by barriers, then apply the drawing.
memory_game.error_too_many_wells: The game supports two to six wells. Simplify the drawing.
memory_game.error_narrow_well: This well is too narrow for the molecules. Make it wider.
memory_game.error_packing_failed: The molecules do not fit in this well. Reduce their count, widen the well, or increase temperature.
memory_game.error_overheat: The temperature limit was exceeded. Change the conditions and try again.
